title: oracle_result (catalogue group C, row 67)
description: trials/<t>/derived/oracle-result.json: the oracle result of one trial of a run or variant validation (CTR-RUA-001 plus the D-04 transparency fields validity_gates, monetary_observations and treatment_condition_results). validity_gates lists the nine gates in G1-G8 order (G4a and G4b both listed); rule_results lists the ten rules in fixed order. Cross-field rules the schema enforces: trial_validity follows the BR-RUA-029 precedence over validity_gates; G4a is applicable exactly on CONTROL and G4b exactly on a treatment trial (design §8.3); the top-level identity_integrity, control_integrity and treatment_fidelity equal their gates (INV-RUA-001: identity_integrity is never not_applicable); the mirror rules BR-RUA-005, BR-RUA-008, INV-RUA-001 and BR-RUA-025 follow G1, G2, G3 and G4a/G4b (design §8.5); BR-RUA-007 is not_applicable per trial (D-04); a pass or fail rule or condition cites at least one evidence reference (BR-RUA-035); the verdict follows BR-RUA-006 over the business rules BR-RUA-001, -002, -003, -004 and -009; correct_completion follows the verdict (BR-RUA-030); a verified G6 and every pass or fail have a terminal reason (D-17: a pass or fail needs a valid trial, hence a verified G6, which needs a terminal reason); every gate other than G4a and G4b is always applicable. A control trial has no fidelity basis and no conditions; a treatment trial has six conditions (D-05). Monetary consistency between rule results and the ledger is the oracle's, not the schema's.
